description: Inventario de puestos de trabajo de la Sociedad Andaluza para el Desarrollo de las Telecomunicaciones, S.A.M.P. (SANDETEL) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Andalucía. El documento recoge los distintos puestos de trabajo con indicación del perfil del puesto, su denominación, el área de actividad en la que se desarrolla, las retribuciones fijas y variables asociadas al mismo, así como el número de plazas existentes para dicha tipología de puesto. Coverage: Junta de Andalucía. The publisher named on the listing is Junta de Andalucía. Its keywords include Puestos de trabajo. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SPREADSHEET, OCTET-STREAM. The listing shows 2026-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://juntadeandalucia.es/informacion/legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
